title: Lia harvested angles re-rendered at still quality
user_request_verbatim: 동영상을 만들든 어떤 방법으로든 다양한 모습을 만들고 네 기준에 맞춰서 스코어링을 해서 보여줘.
source_idea: The turnaround supplies geometry the still engine cannot invent, but only at 576x768 with a face about 160 px across. Feed the accepted frame back into krea2_raw_edit with the master as the second reference: video for the angle, RAW for the identity and the texture.
